messages:
Alex: quick design check — in compact rules list the preview heatmap gets clipped when you reorder priorities, and the validation toast says \"Rule conflict: fix\" which feels unhelpful. noticed on mac/chrome. Priya: thanks Alex. can you paste a quick repro gif? thinking about whether this is layout overflow or canvas clipping Alex: attaching a short gif (uploaded) — when I drag rule 2 above rule 1 the preview panel redraws but the top 8px of the heatmap is missing. also the toast pops up with red X then disappears after 2s so it's easy to miss. Theo: I see two things: 1) preview canvas is absolutely positioned and doesn't recalc height on reorder, 2) toast auto-dismiss too aggressive. agree we should change copy to be more actionable. Sam: fwiw the canvas redraw is triggered by a cheap setState call; we probably can force a layout with requestAnimationFrame and a resizeObserver on the container. cheap fix but might feel janky if not debounced. Priya: ok plan: UX copy tweak + more persistent validation indicator. Theo do you have copy suggestion? Sam can you prototype the resizeObserver approach? Theo: proposed copy: \"Priority conflict detected — overlapping rules may not route traffic as expected. Open preview to inspect and reorder.\" (shortenable). Also change toast to a persistent inline banner in the preview pane with a \"View conflict\" button. Alex: +1 for inline banner. for a11y, the banner should focus and announce on appear so screen reader users hear it. also the current aria-live region only announces \"Error\" which is meaningless. Sam: good catch. current aria-live is polite and only has \"Error\". we can update to assertive and include the message string. code snippet: ```
Priority conflict detected — open preview to inspect.
``` Theo: small UI nit: banner color contrast is low on the orange variant in compact mode. can we use a darker border or switch to a purple/ink outline for better contrast? Priya: if we change color we should keep severity semantics. maybe darken the orange and add a 2px outline. also add keyboard focus style for \"View conflict\" (tab visible). Alex: one more: when View conflict jumps you to the preview it scrolls but doesn't preserve keyboard focus inside the preview. screen reader users can lose context. ideally after clicking it we focus the conflict detail in the preview and set aria-describedby on the preview frame. Sam: noted. I'll implement focus management: focus the first conflict node, and add aria-describedby as you suggested. estimate: small PR, ~1 day. Priya: thanks team. Theo, can you update the mock to show persistent banner + focus state + darker color and post final copy here? I'll add to the sprint. Theo: will do — posting updated mock in ~2 hours. tagging @DesignBot to add an accessibility checklist item for this thread. DesignBot: Accessibility checklist item created: - Ensure toast -> persistent inline banner with aria-live assertive (created) - Focus management when jumping to preview (todo) - Contrast check for banner variant (todo) - Keyboard visible focus for action button (todo) DesignBot: I also created a tracking task in the UX board: UX-4123 \"Preview banner + focus for routing priority conflicts\" Alex: awesome, thanks. small win for accessibility and clarity :thumbsup: Priya: moving this to sprint planning.
